placedBecause: an artifact written by a run outside the test process
armedBy: Two-way control rather than a mutation: the same command over an uncommitted tree produces no run directory at all (CASE-0441), so the artifact's existence and its commit field cannot both be satisfied by a tree that was never named. Strengthened after the fact: the named commit was checked out into a scratch tree with git archive and rebuilt with the same tool, and the ledger came back byte-identical at sha256 ca5f76ff27daf95d04a4ab6d1329529bb6904143a77fdd77899138c48c7fe25e over 582,690 bytes, so the commit field names the tree that actually produced these numbers rather than merely being present.
